Administrative Operations & Delivery (Overseas)
应届-校园招聘
工作地点：圣保罗、利雅得
最多可投递3个职位，但同一时间仅有1个职位流程处于进行中，第一志愿将被优先考虑。
分享
立即申请
岗位职责
Job Responsibilities：
1. Country Administrative Delivery: Own the country-level administrative service delivery for the local office, ensuring day-to-day workplace operations and living support;
2. Market-Entry Project Support: Support the country-launch team on operations, leasing and fit-out, building the local office from 0 to 1;
3. Local Vendor & Team Management: Work with local vendors and the Local Hire team to localize services, balancing HQ standards with local realities;
4. Cross-Cultural Collaboration & AI Enablement: Bridge HQ and local office, and use AI tools to overcome language barriers and improve cross-timezone collaboration.
任职要求
Job Requirements：
1. Bachelor's degree or above, with overseas study/living experience, able to use English as the working language;
2. Adaptable, highly independent and resilient under pressure, able to get things done in resource-limited settings;
3. Reliable and grounded, skilled in cross-cultural communication, passionate about international business;
4. AI Capability: Able to leverage AI tools to overcome language barriers and support administrative delivery.
Preferred: Internship at Chinese companies, or international / cross-cultural project experience; knowledge of and interest in the Latin American (Brazil) / Middle Eastern (Saudi Arabia) market or overseas expansion.
Role Highlights：
1. A rare chance to gain international administrative experience, deeply involved in Meituan's overseas market-entry journey;
2. Build an overseas office from 0 to 1, combining a strong sense of achievement with rapid growth;
